meta.mode_reason: Rich, license-verified WC imagery (18-entry Scout/Designer pool: stadiums, the trophy, crowds, host-city skylines) on an emotional, visual, event-driven topic — the opt-in cinematic scroll is warranted. Backgrounds map 1:1 to the editor's narrative beats; chart-heavy beats (why-believe, money) get the calmer/analytical backdrops so the data stays primary.

global.engine: Pinned full-bleed background stage (position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0) holding one stacked .cin-bg layer per scene. The active scene has opacity:1, the rest 0, crossfaded by a CSS transition:opacity ~1.15s on an .active class toggled by an IntersectionObserver watching each text beat (rootMargin -45% 0px -45% 0px, threshold 0 - the beat whose middle crosses the viewport middle becomes active). framed scenes add a blurred darkened cover .fill backdrop + object-fit:contain .show. The editorial column scrolls in a higher z-index layer over the backgrounds; every chart/table/card sits in an opaque .chart-card surface so it stays legible and keeps a real measured width for the responsive embedChart logic.
global.toggle: A small fixed top-right button (--ui font, gold) labelled 'Cinematic: On' toggles the .cinematic-off class on <html>/<body>: ON shows the stage and the gold surfaces; OFF hides the stage and reverts surfaces to the plain luxury editorial column. State held in a JS variable, default ON (no localStorage).
global.reduced_motion: Under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): drop ken-burns/parallax and the crossfade transition -> each scene's background is a static scrimmed still; the page reads fully with motion off.
global.performance: Background lazy-loaded (loading='lazy', decoding='async') and pre-decoded on load; crossfade is opacity/transform only (compositor), animating just the active +/-1 pair; mobile serves the same compressed JPGs at smaller render and the engine no-ops cheaply when cinematic is off. The hero .teaser video, predictor, simulator, odds table, ratings cards, audio and Leaflet map are untouched and sit above the stage.
global.centerpiece_scene: cin_03 (the 'run it yourself' Monte-Carlo simulator explorable backs edt_02)

_field_notes.beat_coverage: All 9 narrative beats backed: edt_01, edt_predictor, edt_02, ratings, edt_oddsmkt, edt_04, edt_05, edt_03, edt_06. The teaser (hero video) and the references section are intentionally not cinematic scenes - the teaser is the existing full-bleed hero, the references are a plain footer.
_field_notes.verifiability: Every media_ref resolves to a registered Designer des_ or Scout sct_ item in assets/cinematic_imagery_manifest.json; each filename is copied verbatim and the file exists on disk. Each rendered background carries data-cin + data-des/data-sct so the contract gate (validate.py Section 6) can re-check its license + identity.
_field_notes.chart_heavy_calm_backdrops: edt_05 (money) -> calm golden-hour skyline; edt_03 (why-believe) -> the explicit 'calm, darker analytical' empty-seats backdrop, both with the strongest scrims, per the brief.
